newsitem.title: UK: Clyde dismisses Gulf Canada criticism.
newsitem.headline: Clyde dismisses Gulf Canada criticism.

text.p: Clyde Petroleum Plc said its predator Gulf Canada Resources latest criticism of the UK firm's production forecasts showed "lack of knowledge of the North Sea and the latest techniques for field development."
Clyde said its forecasts were based on data not available to Gulf Canada, while adding the Canadian firm made false assumptions on how Clyde intended to develop an important North Sea block.
Clyde said it would make use of sophisticated techniques such as horizontal drilling and fine methods to sift oil from sand, rather than vertical drilling from the existing well.
Gulf Canada on December launched a 432 million stg bid for Clyde Petroleum.
